gaps.why_now: A dedicated Phase 11 build entry now keeps the landed gpio_wdt starter and the survey checkpoint reviewable together instead of letting the lane drift after the first driver scaffold landed.
The survey gate now acts as a freshness check around the landed gpio_wdt starter so the lane does not drift back to pre-driver assumptions or overclaim broader watchdog progress.
The survey note now records the landed gpio_wdt starter and keeps the remaining Phase 11 gap explicit so the lane does not overclaim broader watchdog progress.

The first gpio_wdt starter is now landed and models hw_algo parsing, heartbeat margin validation, and bounded start, stop, ping, and disable transitions without touching live GPIO or platform registration.
Dedicated Phase 11 tests now keep the toggle and level state transitions, heartbeat validation, and always-running stop behavior honest around the landed simple-driver scaffold.
A bounded slice note records exactly what the new gpio_wdt starter covers so later Phase 11 work can extend the model without reopening the starter contract.

The next honest gpio_wdt step is a tiny probe-time summary for always-running startup and registration-facing bookkeeping so the starter can describe more of `gpio_wdt_probe()` before any live GPIO or platform glue.

Platform-driver registration, GPIO descriptor acquisition, watchdog core registration, and reboot integration remain blocked until the lane grows a slightly richer probe model and a hardware-validation plan.
